column1: # The mammalian lipid reaction network, after BioPAN (LIPID MAPS; Gaud et al., F1000Research 2021),
# restricted to the subclasses MS-DIAL annotates in an LC-MS lipidomics run.
# kind says how a reaction maps molecular species onto one another:
#   preserving  the chains are kept; PE 34:1 -> PC 34:1
#   removes     one chain is lost; PC 16:0_18:1 -> LPC 16:0 or LPC 18:1 (needs the chains resolved)
#   adds        one chain is gained; LPC 16:0 -> PC 16:0_18:1 (needs the product's chains resolved)
#   class       only the whole classes relate; Chol -> CE
